records.jp: そういえば、アサガオって貰ったことないかも
records.en_original: Now that I think about it, I don't think I've ever received morning glories.
records.en_auxiliary: Now that I think about it, I don't think I've ever received morning glories.
records.en: Now that I think about it, I don't think I've ever received morning glories.

records.jp: 言われてみれば、花束にアサガオって<CR>入ってるイメージないような
records.en_original: I don't think they're the kind of flower that usually gets included in bouquets.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think they're the kind of flower that usually gets included in bouquets.
records.en: I don't think they're the kind of flower that<CR>usually gets included in bouquets.

records.jp: スタンド花とか楽屋花でも見たことない
records.en_original: I don't think I've ever seen them in the flower arrangements on stage or around the theater before either.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think I've ever seen them in the flower arrangements on stage or around the theater before either.
records.en: I don't think I've ever seen them in the flower arrangements on stage or around the theater before either.

records.jp: 室内に置くのに向いてないのかも
records.en_original: Maybe they don't do very well indoors.
records.en_auxiliary: Maybe they don't do very well indoors.
records.en: Maybe they don't do very well indoors.

records.jp: たしかに、アサガオって外で育ててた記憶ある
records.en_original: I do think I remember hearing that you have to grow them outside.
records.en_auxiliary: I do think I remember hearing that you have to grow them outside.
records.en: I do think I remember hearing that you have to grow them outside.

records.jp: でも、バレエは野外公演ほとんどないし……<CR>正反対の存在なのかも
records.en_original: And I don't think I've ever performed outside... We're like star-crossed lovers, fated to live apart.
records.en_auxiliary: And I don't think I've ever performed outside... We're like star-crossed lovers, fated to live apart.
records.en: But ballet is almost never performed outdoors...<CR>Perhaps we are opposites.

records.jp: そう思うとなんだか惹かれるな、アサガオ。<CR>わたしの知らない世界を知ってる気がして
records.en_original: When I think like that, they seem even more special. A piece of a world I'll never know.
records.en_auxiliary: When I think like that, they seem even more special. A piece of a world I'll never know.
records.en: When I think of it that way, morning glories draw me in.<CR>It feels as though they know a world I do not.

records.jp: じゃあ、私がアサガオで<CR>フラワーアレンジメントしてみせるよ
records.en_original: How about I make a flower arrangement with some morning glories then?
records.en_auxiliary: How about I make a flower arrangement with some morning glories then?
records.en: Then I will make a flower arrangement<CR>with morning glories for you.

records.jp: できるの？
records.en_original: You can do that?
records.en_auxiliary: You can do that?
records.en: You can do that?

records.jp: やったことはないけどね。<CR>たぶんできる
records.en_original: I've never tried, but I think I could.
records.en_auxiliary: I've never tried, but I think I could.
records.en: I've never tried,<CR>but I think I could.

records.jp: その根拠のない自信はどこから来るんだろうね……
records.en_original: Where on earth do you get that confidence from?
records.en_auxiliary: Where on earth do you get that confidence from?
records.en: Where on earth do you get that confidence from?

records.jp: でも、私も言えるようになりたいな。<CR>やったことないことを、やってみようって
records.en_original: I want to start trying out things I've never done before too.
records.en_auxiliary: I want to start trying out things I've never done before too.
records.en: I want to start trying out<CR>things I've never done before too.

records.jp: （そんな深い意味は持たせてなかったけど……。<CR>　日菜子さんはそんな風に考えるんだな）
records.en_original: (I didn't mean anything all that deep... That's what Hinako thinks about, huh?)
records.en_auxiliary: (I didn't mean anything all that deep... That's what Hinako thinks about, huh?)
records.en: (I didn't mean anything all that deep...<CR>That's what Hinako-san thinks about, huh?)

records.jp: ……なんだか、ずっと眺めてたらチュチュに見えてきた
records.en_original: ...Huh. I've been looking at them so long they look like tutus to me now.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Huh. I've been looking at them so long they look like tutus to me now.
records.en: ...Huh. I've been looking at them so long they look like tutus to me now.

records.jp: ほら、がくの方から見ると、スカートみたいでしょ？
records.en_original: Doesn't it look like a skirt when you turn your head?
records.en_auxiliary: Doesn't it look like a skirt when you turn your head?
records.en: Doesn't it look like a skirt when you turn your head?

records.jp: たしかに。てか、本物の花は使ってなくても、<CR>似たデザインの衣装ありそう
records.en_original: You're right. Y'know, they may not use the flower itself, but I bet there are costumes with similar designs.
records.en_auxiliary: You're right. Y'know, they may not use the flower itself, but I bet there are costumes with similar designs.
records.en: You're right. Y'know, they may not use the flower itself, but I bet<CR>there are costumes with similar designs.

records.jp: ただ、アサガオを題材にした演目なんてないからなぁ
records.en_original: I don't think there are any ballets that use morning glories as a theme.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't think there are any ballets that use morning glories as a theme.
records.en: I don't think there are any ballets that use morning glories as a theme.

records.jp: 日菜子さんが作っちゃえば？
records.en_original: What if you made one, Hinako?
records.en_auxiliary: What if you made one, Hinako?
records.en: What if you made one, Hinako-san?

records.jp: 今まで踊ることばかり考えてて、<CR>作りたいなんて考えたことなかった
records.en_original: Huh, I've been so focused on dancing, I never even thought of becoming a choreographer.
records.en_auxiliary: Huh, I've been so focused on dancing, I never even thought of becoming a choreographer.
records.en: Until now, I only thought about dancing.<CR>I had never considered wanting to create one.

records.jp: そっか。踊れなくても、演出家とか振付師とか、<CR>バレエに携わる方法はあるのか
records.en_original: I may not be able to dance anymore, but I could still participate in ballet through that.
records.en_auxiliary: I may not be able to dance anymore, but I could still participate in ballet through that.
records.en: I see. Even if I cannot dance, there are still ways to be involved<CR>in ballet, as a director or choreographer.

records.jp: 儚い衣装だね
records.en_original: I doubt a skirt made out of flower petals would last long.
records.en_auxiliary: I doubt a skirt made out of flower petals would last long.
records.en: I doubt a skirt made out of flower petals would last long.

records.jp: そうだね。もって１、２日かも
records.en_original: True. It would probably only hold together for a day or two.
records.en_auxiliary: True. It would probably only hold together for a day or two.
records.en: True. It would probably only hold together for a day or two.

records.jp: でも、バレエだって生ものだから、<CR>同じ演目でも同じ公演にはならない
records.en_original: But ballet is alive too, you know? No performance is alike.
records.en_auxiliary: But ballet is alive too, you know? No performance is alike.
records.en: But ballet is a living thing too.<CR>Even the same work never becomes the same performance.

records.jp: そう思うと、相性良いと思わない？
records.en_original: Doesn't it seem fitting?
records.en_auxiliary: Doesn't it seem fitting?
records.en: Thinking of it that way, do they not suit each other?

records.jp: そうかもしれないね
records.en_original: Yeah, you may be right.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, you may be right.
records.en: Yeah, you may be right.

records.jp: アサガオっていうとさ、<CR>私は浴衣思い出すんだよね
records.en_original: Morning glories make me think of yukata.
records.en_auxiliary: Morning glories make me think of yukata.
records.en: Morning glories make<CR>me think of yukata.

records.jp: 確かに、アサガオって浴衣の柄でよく見る気がする
records.en_original: Yeah, I believe it's a popular pattern for yukatas.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I believe it's a popular pattern for yukatas.
records.en: Yeah, I believe it's a popular pattern for yukatas.

records.jp: 日菜子さんは浴衣着るなら何の柄がいい？
records.en_original: What kind of yukata patterns do you like, Hinako?
records.en_auxiliary: What kind of yukata patterns do you like, Hinako?
records.en: What pattern would you choose if you wore a yukata, Hinako-san?

records.jp: やっぱりアサガオ？
records.en_original: One with morning glories, right?
records.en_auxiliary: One with morning glories, right?
records.en: One with morning glories, right?

records.jp: かな。色合いも鮮やかだけど<CR>落ち着いてるイメージだし
records.en_original: Yeah, I think so. They have vibrant colors, but give out a calming impression.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, I think so. They have vibrant colors, but give out a calming impression.
records.en: Perhaps. Their colors are vivid,<CR>but they also have a calm image.

records.jp: いいと思うよ！　清楚な感じで
records.en_original: I bet you'd look real classy in one like that.
records.en_auxiliary: I bet you'd look real classy in one like that.
records.en: I think it would suit you! It would look refined.

records.jp: せ、清楚ではないけど……。<CR>ありがとう、悪い気はしないよ
records.en_original: I-I don't know if I'd go that far... But thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: I-I don't know if I'd go that far... But thank you.
records.en: I-I don't know if I'd go<CR>that far... But thank you.

records.jp: ひまわりとかも似合いそうだけど
records.en_original: I think you'd look great in a sunflower pattern.
records.en_auxiliary: I think you'd look great in a sunflower pattern.
records.en: I think you'd look great in a sunflower pattern.

records.jp: ちょっと派手じゃないかな？
records.en_original: I think that might be a bit too much for someone like me.
records.en_auxiliary: I think that might be a bit too much for someone like me.
records.en: I think that might be a bit too much for someone like me.

records.jp: そう？　日菜子さんにはそういう華やかなのも<CR>似合うと思うんだけどな
records.en_original: You think so? I think a bright design like that would look great on you.
records.en_auxiliary: You think so? I think a bright design like that would look great on you.
records.en: Really? I think something glamorous like that would<CR>suit you too, Hinako-san.

records.jp: 華やか、か。<CR>そんなの衣装でしか着たことないよ
records.en_original: Something bright, huh? I've only ever worn stuff like that in costumes.
records.en_auxiliary: Something bright, huh? I've only ever worn stuff like that in costumes.
records.en: Glamorous, huh?<CR>I have only worn things like that as costumes.

records.jp: バレエの衣装着こなせる人は余裕だって
records.en_original: See! Then you're already used to it!
records.en_auxiliary: See! Then you're already used to it!
records.en: See! Then you're already used to it!

records.jp: そ、そう？<CR>もっと明るい色、取り入れてみようかな
records.en_original: Y-you think so? Maybe I'll try wearing more bright colors then.
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you think so? Maybe I'll try wearing more bright colors then.
records.en: Y-you think so?<CR>Maybe I'll try wearing more bright colors then.

records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
